name: Raddai
title: Isaiah's fifth son
summary: Raddai was the fifth son of Jesse from Bethlehem and thus an older brother to King David. He is mentioned only in 1 Chronicles as part of Jesse's sons, and little is known about his life beyond his family connection to David.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jesse's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Raddai is mentioned as the fifth of Jesse's sons in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles, confirming his place in the royal lineage.

keyEvents.title: Not Chosen by Samuel
keyEvents.description: When the prophet Samuel came to anoint one of Jesse's sons as king, Raddai was presented along with his other brothers, but none of them were chosen—the honor went to the youngest, David.
